text: Like another recent review, I haven’t been able to login to the app for 3~ weeks

The introduction of AI is simultaneously helpful and frustrating because there is no way to universally give instructions on how you would like your notes done. You have to give feedback on every single individual note which is time-consuming and then the note has to be rewritten and the system does not appear to remember your feedback from week. So in theory, it could be a wonderfully time-saving feature, but in reality it is far from there yet. Please update the AI so it can remember instructions and add a universal set of rules on how it should do notes for you.

Since the new version I am unable to login. I can login no problem on my computer but each time I step to log in from the app on my phone it opens it as a webpage. When I enter my credentials both username and password boxes go blank.
The calendar is completely useless on this app. It will jump you back-and-forth week to week and sometimes month-to-month when you’re trying to view a single day.
This app stinks. It’s clunky, doesn’t fit the phone screen. Just complete slop. Color scheme stinks, there’s nothing good about it.

It is decent for very very basic functions. It is difficult to find data that you need and good luck getting an answer from support faster than three days. I wish I had started with a whole different software because it was a pain to change, but absolutely worth it! 
There are several better options out there!
and it never ever accepts my password no matter how many times I change it every single time it says your passwords are wrong
This app is lacking a lot of features. The one I’d like to prioritize is one for supervisors so we can sign and confirm notes from our therapists.
Says to update app to reset password but it’s updated and won’t send reset link to email because of it

Default entries are required in client profiles that will automatically override any later billing code changes made elsewhere in the application and will report the default in error. The app will make it look like your entries are saved, but you will be forced to edit the profile before editing and locking the note for that client visit. Highly impractical when you have clients back to back.

The biggest issue that I have is that when using my iPad and the Note Taker feature, the recording fails to upload. Waste of money when paying for a feature that does not work. Spoke to tech support over 2 weeks and was informed they are aware of the issue. However, no update or a refund for the feature not working properly. Searching for a new provider.
New “Privacy” feature does not allow privacy toggle to be switched “on.” When “off,” it allows Simple Practice to collect private client/patient data

There is a toggle that says it is retaining de identified client data Even though I do not use their AI and there is no way to turn it off. I chatted with the AI bot who said don’t worry about it since I don’t use the AI note taker but I want to be able to turn it off! Simple practice get it together before I leave the platform.

Simple practice is fine if the only thing you do is have 50 minute sessions with people who have no cognitive or physical challenges and don’t do any testing. When I asked about accessibility features in my intro “help” session I was told to publish a comment in their suggestion forum and no effort was made whatsoever for improvement. All billing is tied to the calendar which does not work for assessment even when billing in units, and there is not a good way to track deposits on large assessment charges. They push you VERY HARD to their AI chat bot and email for any support, which is very time consuming, (you must wait for replies to every question and 95% of the time my question is lost in translation) and will do everything they possibly can to not talk to you. Also questionnaires, notes, and other templates are extremely limited. However, I’ve been able to find a good platform for assessment/neuropsychology to move to.

I have used this app for over a year and the choice s of provider levels are bare minimum. I do not like that every level gives the provider the cost of service fees!!! I want only admin to have this information and billing. I am leaving and going to a EHR that doesn’t share this information with providers

When looking at my clinician calendar, the name of the month has disappeared. Even when I flip though consecutive months, I have no idea what month it is and must use the TODAY tab to get me back to the current month. Please fix. I will delete the app and try reloading to see if it resolves.

I've used Simple Practice as a clinician for over five years and have never had a problem.Compared to other EHR platforms, it's always been my favorite because it is easy to use and does everything that you need it to. HOWEVER: they suddenly decided to drop support for the telehealth feature on any device older than an iPhone 11. This means that with less than a month's notice, my completely telehealth practice is no longer accessible to over 50% of my current caseload. My clients living in rural areas (who HAVE to use telehealth) cannot afford to upgrade their phone that is working just fine for the sole purpose of being able to join a telehealth session- they also can't afford to go out and buy a computer or tablet to be able to join sessions. when I raised this concern to Simple Practice, I was met with a response that basically consisted of it not being their problem clients won't be able to access care because they are focusing on streamlining support for the telehealth feature to be more focused on only certain versions of devices. Essentially, Simple Practice has put the value of making a dollar over continuity of client care. To be so okay with a huge portion of the client population suddenly losing access to therapy-especially coming from a therapy platform-is absolutely mind-boggling and incredibly disappointing. I don't know of any other EHR system that has made a similar choice in the devaluation of people's wellbeing. If they have been able to support telehealth on all models of technology up until now, it makes zero sense why they cannot continue to do so to allow people can continue to access the care that they need. after being a loyal customer for so many years, I will be going elsewhere and am incredibly sad to have been forced into making that decision.
Ever since the new app update, I cannot read or communicate with my top chat messages from my clients as it is being blocked by a banner.
This app is very limited in functions you need when you’re running a private practice. Frustrating!
Things were great until the most recent update- now I can’t see my virtual appointment slots booked from my phone app.
This app is evil, it takes advantage of clinicians and provides 0 support. It seems convenient at first but you end up spending more work than if you just did everything manually from the start.
This new update won’t let me sign off on my notes. Used to be a flawless system, not a fan of the new glitches.
Notifications always get stuck and never clear out even when you open the app and clear everything out. It always shows a notification energy the app is closed. Very annoying.

Again the app could be so valuable and is. I use it most often. However, there are many bugs that need to continue to be worked out. The newest bug is writing messages. It appears to add words images without even being tapped on. Doesn’t matter if you use voice to text if you’re typing it. Or if you’re clicking on the words, it’s only in this app and it’s happening on. Of our therapist and admin’s phones. Somethings wrong fix it please

First I want to say, while I am certainly grateful to simple practice and that they developed an app for us to use instead of needing to always sign into our computers a lot of times to manage our appointments and scheduling with clients, I find that the app often continues to be glitchy, slow to load, even loses my information when I am trying to set appointments with clients. Over the past 6-8 months, maybe since the big app overhaul a couple of years ago, either an appointment was not saved, was saved for a wrong time or I’ve missed an appointment because the information I put in was not save properly. Now I know this can sound like a me problem and I will own my part in having fat thumbs but a lot of it is that the wheel of death shows up and takes forever to load. Most days, if I need to manually change a clients appointment or put information in, I often don’t trust the app or have to set aside 15 mins for it adjust so I can make changes. I am much more inclined to use my desk top than the app any day. It has been bothersome enough to consider changing our practice system to another product, sadly…and I’ve been with SP since their beta testing. So hopefully something can be done to improve its user interface speed.
Don’t want to be able to finish what you’re saving with a client? This is the platform for you! Good luck!

It’s not just the app, Simple Practice, as a whole, is terrible. It’s flashy but way too expensive for what it offers. If you are a provider, just get used to your claims, sitting untouched for weeks-on-end before you will ever get paid. And forget about customer service or technical support, all you will get is a form email and links to 10 YouTube videos that may or may not slightly address your problem. You cannot submit claims in the app, and, let’s face it, getting paid is why we need a system like this. However, paying its providers is Simple Practice’s LAST priority.

I have used the app multiple times for writing my notes and reading notes and everything else. I don’t like how it moves back to the beginning of the note if I’m typing on it as one person said. Also, I keep getting a reminder to use the simple practice for clinicians and I thought maybe I could change client settings on it since it has been updated and it was saying it was a better experience. But I can’t, for example change how a client receives reminders.
Every time i try to write a note from my phone or iPad, it scrolls back up to the top and i can’t see what I’m writing. Please fix this

Look, the app has gotten a lot better, but it’s still lacks basic functionality for what I need to do on my phone.

Literally the most likely thing I’m going to need to do on my phone away from the office is to write a chart note. 

A client may reach out and need to chat with me or I finally connect with that colleague that I need to consult with and I just need to write a damn chart note to document what’s happening when I am away from the office. But no.

Further, the fact that I can’t turn on an automated away message in the secure messaging is also infuriating. 

I still don’t understand why these two basic functionalities are missing as oodles of are being added, as though people are trying to run their entire practice from their phone.
It’s annoying when writing notes because it scrolls down all by itself while documenting. I tried restarting my phone, deleting and uploading the app again and checked on updates, nothing worked.

I use the app a lot. It’s more convenient for me. I can tell that they’ve tried to make improvements and I appreciate that they are working on it. However, it’s still a little glitchy. The main gripe I have at the moment is that if I’m using the app to write notes when I tap the section I’m trying to type in it automatically scrolls to the bottom of the screen so as I fill out the note I’m scrolling back up to the section I’m filling out over and over again. It’s maddening. Please fix this.

I really liked the press-and-hold feature for appointments when it was first introduced in a recent version, but it was removed in later minor updates. I reached out to customer service several months ago, and they said they would pass my feedback along. However, I’m not sure it ever made it to the development team. I’d love to see this feature brought back.

App is not functioning with last two iOS updates including 18.… Or iOS 26. One. Can't schedule appointments by clicking on the calendar per usual. Appointments are disappearing if you attempt to move them and make a change for future sessions. Appointment disappears or goes to random day or get deleted. Please fix these bugs as my whole business is reliant upon this app functioning properly. Thank you.
With the new update the screen keeps scrolling to the bottom while I’m typing, so you can’t see what you are typing.
Appointment notifications are coming up an hour later. What happening with this app?

Need to add a place for photo IDs to be part of the initial packet. Have asked for years and still no response to this. We should have to option for photo of client too to match ID for records. Simple practice is not just used by therapist.

This app has been super limiting and disappointing. I have a varying schedule every single day and I have found no way to see my availability through the app. It appears as though every hour is available and requires me to think through what times I’m not available in order to book clients effectively for each appointment. No reason why this can’t be transferrable in the mobile version.

This has been going on for several weeks now but my client appointments have stopped loading onto the calendar in the app. The calendar just appears blank. I have to log off and on several times before they eventually populate. It appears I do have the latest version downloaded so no idea what is going on but it’s really affected my workflow with the app and has been very cumbersome to deal with. The app was working fine up until a few weeks ago. Please fix this glitch. I have an IPhone 14 Pro.

I have been using this app for a few years and it has been great until recently. I’m having issues with loading my appointments on the calendar and it’s been a pain to go into the client list to manage the appointment as opposed to doing it through the calendar

I have had an ongoing issue with existing clients not populating in my client list or when trying to schedule an appointment with an existing client. I’ve deleted and reinstalled, the app is up to date - what gives?

Wish they would add an option in the default or event dropdown for “none”. You can change the alert timing for the mobile app, but cannot completely remove it. This is a huge pain for our practice as we use events for notes and openings (we need to see availability and scheduled sessions on the same screen, which is not available with the availability calendar). This means we get mobile alerts for every non scheduled opening OR we have to disable all app notifications.
Used to love this app but now I have to delete and redownload every single session because the schedules and clients don’t save when i close the app

I’ve been using Simple Practice for a while, but the app has become nearly unusable lately. I can’t see my clients on the calendar, so I can’t do any appointments on my iPad. This is especially after the update
I have gone from using this app all the time to not at all because of the last two updates and the inability to see my calendar.

The app is always so glitchy now. I cannot see my patient list unless I click the day 2-3 times between other days? It won’t load for some reason. I cannot bill unless it’s on the computer anymore. It’s just the worst
New app has much more functionality but it it soooo slow. So frustrating
I have used both apps before this updated one and am disappointed with how often the app glitches, does not show my schedule (spinning wheel) or shuts down. This is worse than before.

Ever since the newest update and especially in the last week or two the app is now requiring me to login every day and sometimes multiple times per day. I have deleted the app and re-downloaded it so I definitely have the newest version and this issue is still persisting. This is extremely frustrating and interruptive, please correct and I’ll happily modify my review.

Edit: thank you for fixing the logon issue!! 

My only other request is to please make a faster way to sign our progress notes and make charging the copay one of the first options we see when opening an appt.
The calendar doesn’t advance to the current day so it’s a day behind. This causes a problem when you try to, and it won’t allow you to start the session because it thinks it’s the day before.
It has a lot of features and is easy to use but Telehealth needs to be improved.

The app looks fantastic, but ever since the update to v. 10, calendar sync simply no longer works. Their customer support acknowledges the problem but says it will be “some time” before the issue is resolved. Highly disappointing since this is a major selling point for the higher tier plans. Hoping the resolve the problem soon, but I’m exploring options.

I have not enjoyed this app since the last update. It glitches all the time, and takes forever to pull up my calendar (if it even does). Looking forward bugs being fixed quickly and for the next update.
has been glitching for a few weeks, won’t let me see my client load for the day. please update
I like the recent upgrade to be able to access more features from the app. I really wish I was able to send my patients superbills from the app. Why not make this accessible?
At least on the desktop it will recognize your computer for 30 days. Now this app requires you to sign in every single time you open it is the most annoying thing and slow productivity down to a halt

New update is somehow worse than the previous version. I notice this with their app as well as their website. I am not sure who is approving these changes, but it’s shocking how they are getting less user friendly each time.
I loved SP before the recent updates forcing users to sign in over and over. Please change it back or I will have to look into an alternative EHR

The app works okay. The biggest problem is that it constantly signs me out and requires the 2 step authentication even though on web browsers you can tell it to remember the device for 30 days. It’s slow. It’s tedious and annoying. What’s worse is that I constantly have to force close it to accept my password.
Don’t mind the app, it’s nice to quickly pull up basic information or schedule. I just hate that I have to sign in every couple of days or every day.
This app was great until the latest update. Now I can’t sign in without putting in my entire emails and password, even though I have the pin and Face ID set up.

Absolutely love the updated interface and features, but it'd be nice if I didn't have to sign in to the app 13 times a day because I keep getting logged out after each time I use the app. It's annoying when I just need to do something simple like check my calendar.

The old app worked great. New app gets stuck in a loop of FaceID authentication, requires a new login, and has calendar display bugs, to name just a few of the problems. I wish I could go back to functional.

I loved earlier versions of this app - it made my day to day with clients so much easier to manage. 
This new update is constantly logging me out, or it’s not recognizing my security preferences. I’m either taken straight to the calendar when logging in, or asked to type in my user email and password. Very frustrating when I want to check something quickly without pulling out my laptop.
Since the overhaul, every time I use the app, need to sign in. Please fix!

The old app worked great, I rarely had issues. The new version in 2025 is giving me daily issues. It crashes, it won’t login, basic functions don’t work like payment and scheduling. Yall need to find a way to make the new version like the last one.
Every time they do an update they manage to make this app less usable. Please change the calendar back and for the love of Pete please add an analytics tab with an income snapshot.
Been using sp for years, but recent update has led to major issues meaning I’ve had to delete and reinstall multiple times just to be able to see clients
The app generally works pretty well, but having to log in multiple times a day id extremely annoying. This was not previously an issue, but the latest update seems to have broken something.

I used to use the app for a quick check of my schedule. The last few weeks it has been logging out on its own multiple times a day which makes it super inconvenient and basically unusable. We are paying a lot of money as group practices and I’d like to be able to use this feature. The support team has basically just asked me to be patient. No resolution.
Even with the most recent update that was supposed to fix the sign in issue, I am still having to resign in multiple times a day, making this app near impossible to use
Ever since the latest update, the app keeps logging me out completely and forcing me to sign in again multiple times a day, which is extremely inconvenient.
Why is it every time I open the app I now have to log in. Every once in a while is understandable now every time??

Ever since the major update I have to sign in constantly but it’s sporadic at the same time. When I look up specific clients, it will sometimes freeze on their info and I have to close the entire app, resign in and do it again. There’s no place in the app to report bugs or errors anymore.
Hi, I use this app multiple times a day. What is the point of Face ID and a passcode if you’re still going to make us login multiple times a day? Redundant
The app keeps logging me out between uses, which makes it very hard to get information quickly, especially glancing at notes before sessions

I was already annoyed that the app doesn’t have nearly enough functions as compared to the full website. But after the most recent update, the app sends me to my browser to sign in on the full site with my email and password! I have set up the app to use a passcode or Face ID, which worked perfectly before the update, but NOPE. I have to fully sign in online every single time I open the app. What is the point of the app if it doesn’t work???
Since the new update, the app signs me out nearly every time I close it, even though I have Face ID set up. Then I have to log back in with email and password. What a pain.

I’m very pleased with the app overall…when I can get into it. Ever after the latest update, it logs me out every time and makes logging in a massive pain with 2-factor that sometimes works and sometimes doesn’t. I have Face ID enabled but that doesn’t do anything. I get so frustrated that I give up and just log in on my desktop.

I have loved the convenience of this app and am happy that I can do my notes from my phone if needed. However, gone is the convenience of logging in with Face ID. While it’s still an option, the app requires my login and password every other time I use it. I use Face ID on my phone so I don’t have to memorize my passwords. The developer’s response on 8/8/25 to a review from 7/31/25 said they fixed that with the latest update. It was with the latest update that the app started making me login frequently. Please fix this for real asap.

I have loved SP and its app and as an owner with multiple therapists, the update was great. However, a recent change of having to log in my credentials nearly every time I log in the app, I’m back to using it on safari as it’s not user friendly. Hopefully this is a kink that can be adjusted, otherwise I’m deleting the app as it’s not efficient for me to have to do this step each time I open the app.
It logs me out of the app multiple times a day. Unacceptable functionality

App is good overall but since the refresh I continue to get logged out multiple times daily. I’m updated to the latest version so just hoping this gets resolved soon. I’d also like to be able to set up a passkey to log in more quickly from my phone.

When I could log in, every new screen I went to, I’d have to log back in, and it won’t remember my password in my keychain. Now I can’t even get to a log in screen. It’s just stuck on “loading.” Worked fine before recent update. (8/25)
The recent update was ineffective. I am being logged out of my account daily. I used to love the app but now, it’s become a nuisance to try to use.
Love the app for scheduling purposes. However, I do find myself often going onto my browser to check if claims have been accepted / rejected / paid, and track changes in my projected income.
The app won’t stay logged in, so it’s useless throughout my day when I’m seeing patients. I can’t use it for the purposes I downloaded it for since the new update.

With the latest updates, you constantly have to sign in. You don’t get notifications anymore you can’t look at people inquiring for services. You have to go online on a computer to look at them. The calendar is delayed and it’s a nightmare trying to schedule an appointment because it’s lagging. They made a awful mistake on top of that. We used to have a great tool to go to resources to get printable items for our patients and clients now you can’t search any of those on the website. Now I have to find a new system because this one has turned awful.
Clunky, limited and a step backwards
Since the update I am consistently logged out of my account. Given how often I need to consult my calendar, this is extremely frustrating. Please revert back to the way it was!

Used to use this app everyday to manage my schedule but now this two-factor authentication that fails on the first try every single time has made this so frustrating. I can’t just quickly check my schedule anymore. I have to log in. Then wait for the text. Then have the numbers populate incorrectly. Then have to start the process over again. I get the need for security. But can’t Face ID be enough?? It’s enough for my bank!! I hate this new update.

App update is awful and so disappointing. It frequently signs me out and it claims it fixed this but it did not. I cannot be logging in my info at each session to charge or scheduled next appointment. Please fix this!!!

This app used to be kinda helpful for checking your schedule or getting client contact info. The update was fine (added invoicing to mobile) but now it requires you to sign in after using it. Even if you leave the app to write an email and go back to the SP app you have to login again. This update has made a “kinda useful” app into unusable.
Even with the latest update, the app still requires the entire logging in process after 24 hours. Even after your response to my previous comment. It’s still not resolved.
The update that was just made doesn’t allow me to see any of my schedule appointments. That is the main purpose of the app and it isn’t working now.

This software has been dragging on every device I use on both the high speed networks at the office and home. I have the latest iPadPro and a Mac that’s a couple of years old - it’s not the hardware. It is frustrating to just have your screen hang there. The rollout of latest clinician app was a fumble. Change the color on the app but the icon stays the old color — or is that the old one I’m clicking? Hmmm…could it be because the color keeps changing? Or there was zero clarity during rollout? Who knows. I’m too uncertain to delete either. Calendar is better but not as functional as it should be in the app vs. the web client. 

I should not, as a paying customer, have to figure out the most simple tasks because your rollout was botched. No beta testing I know of at all. 

Nice to get reminders but what good is it if I have to exit the app to address them? Sidebar: more color options to differentiate items on calendar would be helpful. 

Notetaker! I’m a bit annoyed we only had a month of what is clearly a beta product before getting charged for it. It is unpredictable. I do the same thing every session and sometimes I get a note and sometimes I don’t. The app will just randomly stop, it will get hung up at the point of saving the transcription or when “drafting a note.” If you cancel at either point it’s all gone. That said when it works it is an excellent tool. But it remains highly buggy. Paying for a beta product is nothing new but particularly with the ever-expanding use of AI a longer testing process before charging a monthly fee seems reasonable. 

I use another package for a separate piece of my practice and never have the loading issues I have with this. I don’t have time to lose during my day because of poorly functioning software. I should not have to wait or reload just to look at next week’s calendar to schedule a client’s next appointment.

To be clear when it’s all working it’s a good package but increased costs, including an outrageous credit card fee and per claim insurance charges have me looking elsewhere.

I have used the old app for years and it was great. The new app does not allow me to see the calendar unless I refresh it and hold it down with my finger. It blinks on and then goes away. I cannot change my client’s appointments to no show or cancelled. Please fix this.
This app should have never been updated. It’s not user friendly at all.

The app was fine before the update. I’ve had multiple issues and it’s not secure anymore. Sometimes it requires my passcode, mostly it doesn’t even with this security feature turned on. It will randomly turn off my preferred settings and security features. It crashes a lot. It’s been too many weeks of this nonsense for it to not be fixed by now. The service is far too expensive to have it operate so poorly. Customer service is not responsive. They’ve basically been replaced by AI. I wish I had gone with Therapy Notes from the beginning. It’s such a pain to switch but it looks like I’m heading that way.

Overall it’s great but have had several experiences where I have started a session with Note taker and it displays as if it is recording and then there is no recording at the end of session. That’s incredibly frustrating.

I have never seen a platform update this often. Just when I’m learning where new things are, they change it again. Also, this new update is a joke. I haven’t been able to see my clients who are scheduled on the app for a few weeks now. They had me update it, which did nothing. I pay too much in a month for this problem not to be fixed by now. I likely need to find a new platform, Simple Practice has been disappointing and expensive lately.

The new version (July 2025) has too many glitches, including having to login repeatedly, sometimes requiring the designated passcode and sometimes not (ie, when the app keeps me logged in, sometimes it opens without the additional security measure). I thought it was working well before the recent “upgrade” and now it’s inefficient, cumbersome, and apparently less secure. I hope these problems get fixed asap.

I’ve been using this platform and app for years. Ever since they updated I’ve been unable to see my schedule for 2+ weeks. Their online bot service is broken so I haven’t been able to get ahold of a live person to either fix it or give me a refund. I can’t run my practice like this. I’ve deleted and downloaded again. The lack of customer service is even more disappointing than how bad the new update is.

I overall enjoy this app a lot but there are a few things that need to be updated. 
1 when I enroll new clients for some reason setting up notifications seems to not initially work. I always have to go back in clients charts to update that. This is not an issue setting up a new client on my computer. 
2. Since the update scheduling join the right time zone is a hassle. I schedule in up to 3-4 time zones and have a preferred one but since the update it is confusing to know which one I’m scheduling in even with my preferred time zone selected in the settings. This was not an issue before the update.

This is a great app in general, however; Simple Practice has a pattern of releasing updates before they’re ready and it usually takes weeks, if not months for them to get the glitches out before it’s working well again.
This app is terrible. Can barely do anything on it and it is also not user friendly. Somehow got worse after their update.

The latest update has several glitches and I can’t use the calendar view in the month mode because it does not populate my client appointments- they flash on and then disappear. I wish I could uninstall the latest update.
The app looked and worked great before. This update is dreadful. The way it displays the calendar is almost impossible to tell what is going on. Wish I hadn’t updated it.

I used to enjoy this app but since the update it has become unusable. None of my client appointments populate and it flickers on and off each time I try to pull anything up. It has made scheduling on the go impossible.

Disappointing that the new update is buggy. You cannot see your daily appointments (!!!) and system will not refresh. It is still easier to use the browser-based system over this app given limits to functionality.
The new app is buggy. The calendar will not pull up any client scheduled appointments. Would suggest do not update or you’ll be stuck with an app that does not work on your phone.
I’m so grateful for the app. I use it all the time. Since the recent updates, the calendar is taking a longer time to upload.

If finding simple practice useful and streamlined for my budding practice. If I have one gripe it’s that I pay about $40 per month and the one feature that would make things so much easier is calendar sync but it’s hidden behind an extra $30 per month. Well played, ****. Ill keep using the platform and look forward to more updates

I am so glad to be able to access client files from the app now, and to have the AI note taker in the app. Great update. Two suggestions: 1. When using the app to add a document to a client’s file, the “take a photo” option does not allow for cropping, and the photo it appears to be taking is different dimensions after the photo is taken, making it essentially non functional. Can you add back the crop feature? 
2. The old passcode screen with smaller numbers was way better. The image of the buttons seemed better aligned to the function of the buttons. 
I couldn’t find a way to give feedback except here, so maybe a support function aside from the bot would be great as well!

Until last year I would tell any therapist there is simple no better platform fo managing your practice. It handles EVERYTHING. Note taking is totally up to you (compare with platforms that wouldnt let you end the day without completing a note). Scheduling. Messaging. Billing. It does it all really well. Here the hitch and I am looking at YOU SimplePractice. I don't care how secure you say things are, your introduction of AI into the extremely private and personal space of psychotherapy is not cool. The environmental impacts, the security leaks, the way AI has been proven to reduce users' cognitive function?
